_about: UK National Readership Survey social grade. Four source granularities across
the corpus: all six letters (4 studies, 36,133 rows); AB/C1/C2/D/E (EFXNLX,
49,395); AB/C1/C2/DE (both 6MRVOM recipes, 8,923); and PZB01G, which ships
the same six letters in LOWERCASE for four of them -- the same cosmetic drift
as its 'onc' for 'ONC'. Case is normalised; nothing else about it is touched.
AB and DE are kept as canonical values in their own right rather than being
resolved. A study that pre-merged A and B cannot be un-merged, and a canonical
value must never claim a precision its source lacks.
